responsibility: Declares the AVR backend’s machine-description operand constraints for registers, immediates, memory forms, and fixed-point constants. These constraints describe AVR-specific register classes such as pointer and ADIW-capable pairs, direct-memory forms like Y/Z with displacement, and many constant classes tailored to AVR instruction encodings and bit-manipulation idioms, allowing `avr.md` patterns to precisely control matching, reload, and instruction selection.
